d:
Mexico has captured one of the FBI's 10 most-wanted fugitives. Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as 'El Chapo Isidro', was arrested in a major military operation in Sinaloa.
But the operation sparked deadly clashes, leaving 11 people dead, including four Mexican soldiers. Cartel gunmen also set vehicles ablaze and blocked highways. Who is El Chapo Isidro, and what does his capture mean for Mexico's drug cartels?
